name: EPC Groupe
summary: EPC Groupe engages in the manufacture, storage, and distribution of explosives in Europe, Africa, Asia Pacific, and the Americas. The company offers matrix and cartridge explosives, detonators, and boosters. It also provides drilling and blasting services; demolition services, including mechanical demolition, deconstruction and blasting of buildings, waste management, and asbestos removal; and related training services. In addition, the company is involved in underground, tunnels and infrastructure works. It serves customers operating in the mining, cement, aggregates, civil engineering, and defense industries.
